name: Mattithiah
overview: The name Mattithiah appears in Scripture as belonging to several individuals who served in various roles within the Levitical and temple worship systems. Notably, Mattithiah was a Levite entrusted with overseeing the baked offerings (1 Chronicles 9:31), and also served as a chief or leader among temple musicians, including the fourteenth division of singers and instrumentalists under Jeduthun (1 Chronicles 25:21). Additionally, Mattithiah stood alongside Ezra as a prince during the public reading of the law, highlighting his leadership in the spiritual restoration of Israel (1 Chronicles 9:31; 1 Chronicles 15:18-21; 1 Chronicles 25:3, 21). These references collectively emphasize Mattithiah’s dedication to worship, musical ministry, and covenantal fidelity among God’s people.
